note: Stage-3b acceptance criteria, evaluated by tools/rootcause_diag.py --base A0 --variants ... on the ALL-grades cluster-bootstrap 95% CI of the paired variant-minus-base difference. ASSUMED thresholds (the written plan of 12.10 was not available to the author): edit this file to the plan's numbers. guardrail = non-inferiority: the CI bound on the bad side must stay inside `margin` (units = metric * scale). gain = point effect at least `min_effect` in the good direction AND the CI excludes 0. A variant ADVANCES iff every guardrail passes and at least `min_gains` gains pass.
